market_fusion_rule: Fixed 0.1 simplex and temperatures 0.8/1/1.25; fit complete-case actual pre-cutoff OOF calibration records only. Freeze before test; if unavailable H-M remains untested, with no replacement period or model chosen after test scores.
comparison_rule: Each hypothesis must pass every listed reference at protocol alpha/3; intersection-union, no favorable reference selection. Other R families remain exploratory on this holdout, not discarded.
missingness: O/R comparison on matched primary-horizon predictions; market comparison on predeclared matched complete-market subset. Report all scheduled, excluded and unmatched counts; never silently equate denominators.
boundary_rule: Exclude meetings overlapping model or fusion training/calibration; do not fit on any test labels. Previous published outcomes may update numerical history for later races, without updating frozen weights.
no_peeking: Operational checks may inspect capture times, identities, missingness and label availability. Do not inspect aggregate predictive performance for the test window before unlock; no interim selection, early success stopping or effect-driven extension.
power_basis: Development GNN-fusion meeting variance suggests approximately 2191 races for 90% power at assumed true 0.10 nats improvement over delta=0.005. Raised targets are 3000 races/100 meetings/60 days. This does not guarantee power for smaller effects or for H-M, whose market variance is unknown. Fixed end with insufficient count remains inconclusive.
adoption: inconclusive until every unchanged charter gate passes, including historical provenance and all registered component probes
